OUR STORY

For data people. By data people.

Matia was born out of simple necessity. You shouldn't need 7 different tools to manage your data stack. It's that simple.

‍ Founders Ben and Geva Segal, both leading data and engineering teams, noticed their teams were spending time integrating their data stacks and maintaining and building unreliable systems - time that could have been spent on more crucial engineering and business work.

So they spoke to more than 100 data leaders about the problems they were seeing, and the response was clear: If they could find a way to move, monitor and view data in one integrated platform, and provide deeper observability earlier in data pipelines, they would sign up.

And the idea for Matia was born: A unified approach to managing and using data. While the idea of Matia is simple, building the platform has been anything but. The platform combines the power of ETL, observability, catalog, and reverse ETL into one platform, creating an end-to-end data experience and allowing data, engineering and ai teams to have more control over DataOps, AI systems, and business outcomes.
‍
Less headaches. More functionality. Get your data working for you. It can and should be that simple.

Building Our Culture

Every company claims to be customer centric and trust us, we love our customers, but at the heart of Matia sits our employees. These are the cultural we’ve built and will continue to build.

Own your Craft

Mastery comes from dedication and continuous learning. We move with urgency and take full ownership of our work and our careers. Excellence and speed can coexist when we operate with intention.

Clarity is Kindness

Clarity is essential. But being direct doesn’t mean being unkind. We speak with intention and check our egos at the door because the best ideas win when we listen and assume good intent. 

Think Boldly, Execute Thoughtfully

A lot of people are big ideas people or meticulous executors. We’re both. We challenge assumptions, explore ambiguous ideas, and make sure we bring them to life with precision and focus.

Earn Trust in Every Interaction

Trust is gained in drops and lost in buckets. Every customer interaction, team commitment, and decision shapes our collective credibility. Transparency, integrity, and accountability are non-negotiables. We do what we say, own our mistakes, and show up consistently, because trust isn’t built overnight.
